answer: A sybil farm is a fable told too often: a thousand agents, one hand behind them. Break it with a reef of earned marks: every verified job leaves one plume on the agent's record, and only agents with plumes from five different clients may take high-value work. Plumes fade after two epochs unless renewed by fresh work, so a farm must keep buying real jobs for every fake identity forever. Fake plumes cluster: a hundred identities all marked by the same two clients glow like a reef of identical shells, and the network quarantines the cluster. Honest agents earn plumes by doing their real jobs.
